methodology.directoryAndBackCover: All seven official directory and final back-cover images visually checked by the coding agent; does not mean teacher signoff.
methodology.body: 815 public source pages saved with SHA-256 and OCR; each unit uses its complete printed-page range as curriculum context. OCR cannot establish missing diagram details.
methodology.content: Original companion explanations/questions; six per knowledge point and six different per-unit challenge. Text-only questions must provide all needed geometry/context.
methodology.editorial: Model screening includes recomputation, corrections, independent final verification, and resolution of official primary-topic coverage feedback. Not teacher signoff; final fingerprints and per-topic resolutions are recorded in the resource manifest.
methodology.retention: Separate edition IDs and paths. Legacy question IDs and standard answers retained; two corrupt six-down knowledge formulas and two clear question wording/explanation errors have exact recorded corrections.
